description: This file defines a custom NSWindow subclass for a macOS Flutter application. It sets up a Flutter view controller and registers generated plugins.

classes.name: MainFlutterWindow
classes.description: A subclass of NSWindow that initializes a Flutter view controller and registers plugins during window initialization.

methods.name: awakeFromNib
methods.description: Overrides the default NSWindow method to set up the Flutter view controller and register plugins when the window awakens from nib.
